name: Rad Streams
description: Internet radio stations as TV channels: photos of each station's city, the current track and local weather, with the station playing underneath.
author: Bob

fields.label: Setup
fields.description: Add your stations to the table below, press Save Settings, then press Sync Stations. Each station becomes a channel in the Rad Streams group. Channels render only while someone is watching. Sync and Validate run in the background with a progress bar; each saves a full report in /data/rad_streams/reports (the latest is also in /data/rad_streams/logs).

fields.label: Stations
fields.description: One row per station. Name, Stream URL and City or Theme are required. City: use 'City, ST' or 'City, Country' when a name is ambiguous, e.g. Seattle, WA. Theme: put Theme: and a subject in the City column for photos of that subject instead (no weather), e.g. Theme: Space. Built in: Space, Earth, Nature, Ocean, Mountains, Forest, Waterfalls, Desert, Aurora, Sunsets, Beaches, Lakes, Wildlife, Night Sky; any other word is searched on Wikimedia Commons. Channel # is optional (blank picks one from 1000 up). Keep ID: when you rename a station, put its old name here so it keeps its channel. Logo URL: an http(s) image for the channel logo (blank = the Rad Streams logo). Skip: tick to take a station off without deleting its row. Icecast/Shoutcast, .pls/.m3u and HLS (.m3u8) stream URLs all work. Save, then press Sync Stations: Sync checks every cell and changes nothing until every row is right.

fields.label: Text Movement
fields.help_text: Burn-in protection: the text moves to a new spot on every photo change.

fields.label: Photo Credits
fields.help_text: Photo and weather licences require a credit; brief shows it when each photo appears, then fades it out.

fields.label: CPU Use
fields.help_text: Low uses about a third less CPU per station with software encoding. Crossfades between photos look a little less smooth.

fields.label: Video Bitrate (kbps)
fields.help_text: Upper limit per station. Still pictures use less with software encoding.

fields.label: Video Encoding
fields.help_text: A GPU takes the video encoding off the CPU. The container needs the GPU passed through (/dev/dri, or the NVIDIA runtime). Sync tests it and uses software encoding if it doesn't work.

fields.label: Server Port
fields.help_text: Local port for the channel streams (127.0.0.1 only). Change it if something else uses it.

actions.label: Sync Stations
actions.description: Check the stations table, then create, update and remove channels to match it and start the stream server. Runs in the background.

actions.label: Validate
actions.description: Check each stream, its track titles, the city and available photos. Runs in the background and saves a full report.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Show whether the stream server is running and which stations are being watched.

actions.label: Stop Server
actions.description: Stop the stream server. Channels stay; Sync starts it again.

confirm.title: Stop Rad Streams?
confirm.message: Anyone watching a Rad Streams channel will be disconnected.

actions.label: Remove All Channels
actions.description: Stop the server and delete every channel this plugin created.

confirm.title: Remove Rad Streams channels?
confirm.message: This deletes every channel and stream in the Rad Streams group that this plugin created.
